ayderyaylasi.name: Ayder Plateau
ayderyaylasi.slogan: Wooden chalets, hot springs and the Kaçkar peaks above.
ayderyaylasi.line: Ayder sits at about 1,350 m, and its hot springs, around 55°C, were first recorded in official papers in 1871.

zilkale.name: Zil Castle
zilkale.slogan: A tower on a rock, with the Fırtına roaring below.
zilkale.line: It stands on a rocky outcrop about 1,130 m up and was restored between 2008 and 2010.

rizekalesi.name: Rize Castle
rizekalesi.slogan: Look down on the city, then up at the tea-striped hills.
rizekalesi.line: The lower castle is dated to the 13th century, when it guarded this stretch of the Black Sea coast.

senyuvakoprusu.name: Şenyuva Bridge
senyuvakoprusu.slogan: One stone arch, a river gorge and a century of selfies.
senyuvakoprusu.line: About 40 m long and 20 m above the river, it is dated to 1696 or 1699; the inscription was lost in a 1946 flood.

ziraatcay.name: Ziraat Botanik Tea Garden
ziraatcay.slogan: Tulip glass in hand, the sea at the end of the terraces.
ziraatcay.line: The Ziraat Botanical Garden was founded in 1924 as a tea and citrus nursery, the year a law began tea growing in Rize.
